name: DJ
spec: A DJ and a sound system sized to your venue
material: Whatever mix of music you'd like
alt: A hand on a jog wheel of a pair of DJ decks.
blurb: Book a DJ on their own or to carry a late night set after the band wraps their set. All run by the same team, with the same contract. A solid DJ gets people moving and is the most common single booking of the corporate season.

hybrid.label: DJ plus live instrument
hybrid.copy: We can add a live musician on bass or saxophone to play along with the DJ. It gives your guests a live performance to watch, and it can keep people dancing late into the night. Just let us know if that sounds like a good fit for your event.
